inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read This Placement in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Read Mars in Aries in Your Chart
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading a Mars in Aries placement by house, aspects, Moon, and recovery pattern

items.subEn: Mars in the third house may bring quick speech; in the seventh, directness surfaces most clearly in close partnerships
Recall a recent choice where you acted before everyone else was ready—was speed necessary or just safer than waiting?
A trine can make the drive easier to express; a square shows competing priorities that call for more deliberate timing
The Moon describes emotional habits, showing whether the outward response matches the private feeling underneath
After a disagreement or demanding task, observe whether action restores focus or a short break produces a clearer next move

inline.titleEn: 4 Common Misreadings of Mars in Aries
inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of a Mars in Aries placement, from anger stereotypes to leadership guarantees

items.subEn: The placement can describe a quick ignition point but does not measure emotional maturity or frequency of anger
Sun sign and Mars placement describe different chart functions; the rest of the chart still matters
Directness can be concise, brave, and respectful—the issue is checking timing and impact, not whether you speak plainly
It can support a willingness to start or take visible risk, but leadership also depends on judgment, skill, and relationships
